title: Overthinking & Anxious Mind
description: When thoughts race uncontrollably, imagining worst-case scenarios and feeling paralyzed by worry.
samplePrompts: I cannot stop overthinking about the future and what might go wrong.
My mind is constantly racing at night and I feel like I have lost control of my thoughts.
How do I quiet the anxiety inside me when everything feels overwhelming?

title: Career, Ambition & Failure
description: Navigating professional setbacks, fear of failure, burnout, and finding purpose without obsessing over outcomes.
samplePrompts: I worked so hard for a promotion or exam and failed. I feel completely worthless.
I am burning out trying to prove myself to everyone and constantly comparing myself to peers.
How can I stay motivated to work without being terrified of failing?

title: Relationships & Heartbreak
description: Healing from broken trust, detachment, boundary setting, and learning to love without suffocating expectations.
samplePrompts: Someone I trusted deeply broke my trust or walked away. How do I let go?
I get excessively attached to people and then suffer when they don't value me.
How do I deal with constant conflict and hostility in my relationship?

title: Family Pressure & Expectations
description: Managing expectations from parents, guilt over choosing your own path, and family disagreements.
samplePrompts: My parents have high expectations for my life, but my heart yearns for something else. I feel guilty.
There is constant friction and misunderstanding within my household.
How do I fulfill my duty to my family without sacrificing my own integrity?

title: Fear, Grief & Loss
description: Coping with the loss of a loved one, existential dread, fear of sickness, and finding inner solace.
samplePrompts: I recently lost someone I love and the grief feels like a physical ache in my chest.
I am gripped by an intense fear of sickness, aging, or losing people close to me.
Why is there so much suffering and impermanence in this world?

title: Moral Dilemmas & Big Decisions
description: Standing at a crossroads, feeling lost about the right action, and finding clarity when all options seem hard.
samplePrompts: I am facing a major life decision and cannot tell which path is right or ethical.
I feel completely lost and have lost my sense of purpose.
How do I distinguish between ego's desire and what is truly my Dharma?

title: Anger & Bitter Resentment
description: Overcoming deep-seated anger, irritation with others, and toxic resentment eating away at peace.
samplePrompts: I get triggered easily and say hurtful things in anger that I later regret.
I hold deep resentment against someone who wronged me in the past.
How do I dissolve the anger burning inside me?

title: Loneliness & Self-Doubt
description: Feeling unseen, unloved, defective, or isolated even in a crowded world.
samplePrompts: I feel deeply lonely, like nobody truly understands or cares about me.
I struggle with low self-esteem and feel fundamentally inadequate.
How can I find peace when I feel isolated and disconnected from everyone?
